'''DecipherCon 1999 Progressive Sealed Deck''' was a Star Wars CCG side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). Decipher posted two differing score sheets and recorded no overall winner.<ref name="dc99sw22_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW22_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Progressive Sealed Deck], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000525001947/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW22_1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99sw22_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW22_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Progressive Sealed Deck], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001101003044/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW22_2.html Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Type:''' Side event (Progressive Sealed Deck)

== Notes ==

* Sheet 1 (34 players, 5 games) is topped by Martin Akesson; sheet 2 (68 players, 4 games) is topped by Mitchell Velasco.<ref name="dc99sw22_1" /><ref name="dc99sw22_2" />
* The source does not say whether these are two flights, two separate events or two stages of one event, and records no overall winner.
